Third-party artwork compatibility assets

These marks identify the original plugins; they are not Tanuki Toolbox branding.
Prefer each installed package's own declared icon over these compatibility fallbacks.

dshmarket.svg: unmodified assets/logo.svg from dsh-market/dsh-market
Commit: ba73a3988bb3eee82295a695d59be59563637350

skills-manager.svg: SKILL_PATHS from MichengAI/dsh-skills-manager/src/settings-nav-icon.ts, wrapped in a standalone SVG. Displayed as a mask to retain the settings glyph's inherited color.
Commit: 4fcbfe648a7abe3a21c1f78cd63406262eae9d6b

No author avatar or generic DeepSeek brand asset is used as a plugin icon.
